description: Video metadata for YouTube channels and video URLs, no transcripts. mode 'feed' (default) returns a channel's latest uploads, up to 15 per channel: title, date, views, likes, description, thumbnail ($1 per 1,000 videos). mode 'full' returns every watch-page field (duration, comments, subscriber count, shorts flag, channel handle) for up to 100 videos per call ($3 per 1,000). Video URLs always return full rows. Billed per video returned, never for failures. Same result as POST /api/v1/youtube/videos. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

channels.description: Up to 10 channels: an @handle, a youtube.com channel URL, or a UC channel id.

limit.description: Videos per channel: 1-15 in feed mode, 1-100 in full mode.

mode.description: 'feed' (latest uploads, cheap) or 'full' (all fields, deeper history).

videos.description: Up to 100 YouTube video URLs or 11-character ids.

name: scrape_youtube_videos
title: Scrape YouTube videos
